summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing a private placement of up to $19.4 million. The company agreed to sell 8,571,429 ADSs (each representing 10,000 ordinary shares) with Series A-1 and A-2 warrants at a combined price of $0.70 per ADS. The Series A-1 warrants have an exercise price of $0.86 per ADS, exercisable immediately for five years, and Series A-2 warrants have an exercise price of $0.70 per ADS, exercisable immediately for 18 months. H.C. Wainwright is the placement agent. The offering is expected to close June 22, 2026, with $6 million in upfront gross proceeds. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation as defined.
